newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere ends week down on lower turnover.
newsitem.headline: Solidere ends week down on lower turnover.

text.p: Solidere shares fell on sharply decreased turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange in the week ended on Friday and dealers said the absence of blocks of demand orders pushed prices down.
A shares fell to $111.875 from $113 last Friday and B shares closed at $115.875 from $117.125.
Turnover in Solidere shares was 34,852 shares from last week's 91,748 shares and value was $3,962,037 against $10,431,317.
"Blocks of demand orders that were setting prices during the previous weeks vanished this week, hence the volume fell sharply and prices went down," one dealer said.
There was no trade in the shares of the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.31 percent on the week to 82.46 and the BLOM stock index also fell 0.85 percent to 958.6.
